Come Build With Us and Join One of the Fastest-growing Infrastructure Platform Companies

AI/ML and Infrastructure Engineers – We’re Looking for You

At ClearML, we’re revolutionizing AI infrastructure by making scalable computing effortless for IT teams and AI builders around the world. Our mission is to empower AI builders and IT teams in accelerating their AI workflows with a seamless, optimized experience. Join us and help shape the future of effortless AI infrastructure management for every phase of AI production, where your expertise will drive cutting-edge solutions and impact the way businesses harness the power of AI today and tomorrow.

Engineering

Customer Success Manager

Company Overview

ClearML delivers a comprehensive AI infrastructure platform for enterprise-scale AI management. Our solutions optimize GPU utilization, automate workflows, and enable secure AI deployments across hybrid setups. Backed by NVIDIA and trusted by thousands of AI teams worldwide, ClearML drives efficiency for innovative organizations across every vertical. We operate fully remotely and prioritize personal accountability, growth, and a culture that values diverse perspectives.

Role Summary

As a Customer Success Manager at ClearML, you will be the primary relationship owner for a portfolio of enterprise accounts following the initial sale. You will serve as a trusted advisor and advocate, ensuring customers realize measurable value from the ClearML platform at every stage of their journey. This is a high-impact, relationship-first role that blends strategic account management with a genuine commitment to customer outcomes. You will partner closely with Sales, Product, and Support to align ClearML’s roadmap with customer needs and translate platform capabilities into business results.

Key Responsibilities

 

Relationship & Account Management

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts as the primary post-sale point of contact, building deep, trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Conduct regular cadence calls, business reviews, and executive check-ins to maintain alignment on goals, progress, and evolving priorities.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of each customer’s organizational structure, AI/ML strategy, and success criteria to deliver a tailored engagement.
  • Act as a proactive partner, anticipating customer needs and surfacing opportunities before they become challenges.

Adoption & Value Realization

  • Guide customers through onboarding, ensuring a smooth and structured ramp onto the ClearML platform.
  • Drive adoption of core and advanced product capabilities, helping customers connect platform features to measurable business outcomes.
  • Share best practices, use-case guidance, and enablement resources to continuously deepen customer engagement with ClearML.
  • Track and communicate progress against agreed success milestones and adoption targets.

Issue Engagement & Escalation

  • Serve as the customer’s internal champion, triaging reported issues and coordinating timely resolution with Support and Engineering.
  • Maintain visibility into open tickets and escalations, providing proactive updates and ensuring customers feel heard and prioritized.
  • Escalate critical issues with appropriate urgency and context, managing customer expectations with transparency and professionalism throughout.

Retention & Growth Monitor

  • account health signals and proactively address churn risk through early intervention and remediation plans.
  • Identify expansion opportunities — including upsell and cross-sell — and collaborate closely with Account Executives to progress them.
  • Lead renewal conversations in partnership with Sales, ensuring strong renewal outcomes anchored in demonstrated customer value.

Voice of the Customer Represent

  • the customer’s perspective internally, providing structured feedback to Product and Engineering on feature requests, gaps, and priorities.
  • Contribute to ClearML’s CSM practice by sharing playbooks, customer insights, and lessons learned across the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role within a B2B SaaS or technology company.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and sustain strong executive and practitioner-level relationships across complex, multi-stakeholder accounts.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including experience managing renewals, mitigating churn risk, and identifying growth opportunities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill complex technical concepts into clear business narratives.
  • High degree of organization and follow-through, with experience managing a portfolio of accounts and multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Collaborative mindset and comfort working cross-functionally across Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering.
  • Comfort with AI/ML concepts and ability to develop fluency in technical platforms without being a deep practitioner.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in MLOps, AI infrastructure, cloud, or developer tooling spaces.
  • Familiarity with enterprise AI/ML workflows and the stakeholders who own them (data scientists, ML engineers, IT/infrastructure teams).
  • Track record working in a fast-moving, distributed environment with global teams and customers.
  • Experience with CRM and CS tooling such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar platforms.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation including base salary, performance incentives, and equity participation.
  • Fully remote work with flexible scheduling across time zones.
  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and wellness programs (where applicable by region).
  • Ongoing professional development, including access to industry events and customer success communities.
  • A culture built on trust, accountability, and meaningful impact — where every CSM is an owner of customer outcomes.

Solutions Engineer

Company Overview

ClearML delivers a comprehensive AI infrastructure platform for enterprise-scale GenAI,  LLMOps, and MLOps. Our solutions optimize GPU utilization, automate workflows, and enable secure AI deployments across hybrid setups. ClearML maximizes AI performance while minimizing costs.

Backed by NVIDIA and trusted by thousands of AI teams worldwide, ClearML drives efficiency for innovative organizations across verticals. Operating fully remotely, we prioritize personal accountability, growth, and a dynamic culture that values diverse perspectives.

Role Summary

The Solutions Engineer at ClearML is a technical powerhouse on the sales team, combining engineering expertise with sales acumen to drive revenue. You’ll demonstrate ClearML’s platform through tailored demos, address technical hurdles, and build trust with partners and prospects in AI/ML-focused enterprises. This role involves closely partnering with Account Executives to convert opportunities into wins by showcasing how ClearML solves real-world challenges in AI orchestration, resource utilization, and deployment. Focus on pre-sales technical validation, demos, and securing the “technical win,” including working with partners to co-deliver solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with sales teams to conduct deep technical discovery sessions, identifying prospect pain points and mapping ClearML features to solve technical challenges; understand and capture requirements for custom solutions.
  • Serve as the technical expert in sales meetings to handle objections, fielding advanced questions on architecture, security compliance, API capabilities, and tech stack compatibility to remove purchase barriers.
  • Deliver compelling technical presentations, product demonstrations, and POCs highlighting ClearML’s features like AI Development Center, GenAI App Engine, and Infrastructure Control Plane; design and lead online/face-to-face demos.
  • Collaborate with technology partners (e.g., NVIDIA, AMD, HPE) and solution providers (e.g., system integrators, consultants) to co-develop integrated solutions, joint POCs, and demonstrations that showcase interoperability and added value.
  • Respond to technical questions, RFPs, and objections during sales cycles, providing solutions for integration, scalability, and security, often in concert with channel partners.
  • Conduct discovery calls to map client infrastructure (e.g., on-prem GPUs, cloud clusters) to ClearML’s capabilities, identifying direct opportunities and partner-led opportunities.
  • Collaborate on solution proposals, including architecture diagrams and ROI analyses, incorporating partner ecosystems for enhanced offerings.
  • Post-sale, support onboarding, handoff to customer success, and design example code/utilities for customers and partners.
  • Stay updated on AI trends, competitor products, and best practices to refine sales strategies and contribute to product enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent; B.Sc. preferred.
  • 3+ years in sales / solution engineering, preferably in SaaS, Infrastructure, AI/ML, or cloud tech
  • Strong presentation and demo skills, with ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences; comfortable presenting and discussing technical ideas.
  • Proven track record in supporting sales quotas and closing deals.
  • Excellent problem-solving, interpersonal, and communication skills in English
  • High ability to translate complex technical concepts/challenges into business outcomes – can speak to practitioners and executive level audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years in AI, ML/DL, or data science focused roles
  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML tools, Python scripting (1+ years), APIs, infrastructure (e.g., Kubernetes, cloud APIs), and data science concepts
  • Experience with MLOps platforms (e.g., ClearML, Databricks) or GenAI technologies
  • Background in enterprise software sales, consulting, post-sales technical support, or working with partners in tech ecosystems (e.g., resellers, integrators)

What We Offer

  • Attractive base and variable salary
  • Remote flexibility with global collaboration opportunities
  • Health benefits, 401(k), and generous vacation policy
  • Continuous learning through conferences, training, and AI-focused projects
  • Cutting edge technology environment where innovation and teamwork thrive.

Join ClearML to shape the future of AI sales!

Senior Python Engineer (IC)

Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time
Preferred Locations: Greece, Spain, or Italy

About the job

At ClearML, our mission is to make infrastructure management effortless across every phase of the AI lifecycle — from building and training AI models to large-scale production. Trusted by more than 2,100 organizations, AI builders and IT teams use our AI infrastructure platform to power everything from early-stage R&D to mission-critical public sector and enterprise-grade AI pipelines.

We’re growing quickly and looking for curious, self-driven individuals who are excited to shape the future of AI and the infrastructure that powers it. Our customers are tackling some of the world’s most important challenges — revolutionizing healthcare, discovering new medicines, securing global finance, protecting national security, and preserving our planet’s ecosystems.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Python Engineer with a very strong background in building high-performance, scalable systems. The ideal candidate is an experienced problem-solver who understands how to design, implement, and optimize complex and secure applications across both client and server environments. Candidates should be comfortable working from home, collaborating with a dynamic and vibrant team from all around the world. The products and technologies you’ll build and maintain will be used by thousands of companies around the world as well as numerous independent developers, data scientists and engineers.

ClearML is a fully-remote, open-source company which promotes independence and personal growth and accountability – we look for people who thrive in environments where the technology you develop quickly affects the work and productivity of people around the world. If you like getting quick feedback from real-world users, rapidly shipping features and technologies to production and seeing the difference you make, ClearML is the place for you!

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, high-quality Python applications.
  • Build and optimize multi-threaded and asynchronous processes for performance and reliability.
  • Work on both server-side and client-side Python components, ensuring seamless communication and integration.
  • Manage and optimize data storage and retrieval using MongoDB and Elasticsearch, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and memory efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to architect solutions that meet business and technical objectives.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and improve system stability and monitoring.
  • Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and best practices for Python development.
  • Maintain a high-level of secure development and security awareness.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional experience developing in Python.
  • Proven experience with multi-threaded or asynchronous applications.
  • Strong knowledge of MongoDB and Elasticsearch, including indexing, query optimization, and memory/performance tuning.
  • Experience in both client-side and server-side Python environments.
  • Solid understanding of software design principles, data structures, and algorithmic efficiency.
  • Proven experience developing REST APIs services, messaging systems, and distributed architectures.
  • Strong debugging and profiling skills.
  • Experience collaborating effectively in distributed or remote teams.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently or as part of a team.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Experience in building and packaging Python libraries (wheels) and deploying to PyPI.
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or other cloud environments.

Advantage

  • Background in data engineering, analytics, or observability systems.
  • AI driven system

Solutions Architect

Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time
Preferred Locations: Portugal or Spain

At ClearML, our mission is to make AI infrastructure effortless across every phase of the AI lifecycle — from building and training models to large-scale production. Trusted by more than 2,100 organizations worldwide, AI builders and IT teams use our platform to power everything from early-stage R&D to enterprise-grade AI pipelines.

We’re growing quickly and looking for curious, driven individuals who are excited to shape the future of AI and the infrastructure that powers it. Our customers tackle some of the world’s most important challenges — revolutionizing healthcare, discovering new medicines, securing global finance, protecting national security, and preserving our planet’s ecosystems.

About the Role

We are seeking a Solutions Architect who combines deep technical expertise with strong communication and problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate has a solid engineering background — ideally as a hands-on developer or DevOps engineer — and is eager to bridge the gap between technology and business outcomes.

As a Solutions Architect at ClearML, you will work directly with enterprise customers to design, deploy, and scale AI infrastructure solutions using ClearML’s platform. You’ll collaborate with data scientists, MLOps teams, and IT engineers to ensure success across the AI lifecycle — from experimentation and model training to deployment and monitoring.

This is a hands-on role that requires technical excellence, clear communication, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Responsibilities

  • Engage with enterprise customers to understand their technical challenges, architecture, and goals.

  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and efficient ClearML-based solutions on Kubernetes and cloud/hybrid environments.

  • Lead technical workshops, proofs of concept (POCs), and architecture reviews.

  • Present complex technical concepts in a simple, business-oriented manner.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful adoption and expansion.

  • Provide guidance and best practices for deploying AI workloads on Kubernetes clusters.

  • Troubleshoot customer environments and provide hands-on support during deployment and onboarding.

  • Contribute to documentation, solution templates, and reusable technical assets.

Requirements

  • Strong Hands-on expertise in Kubernetes — deep understanding of architecture, scaling, and operations.

  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal — able to explain complex topics clearly and effectively.

  • Prior experience as a software engineer, DevOps engineer, or MLOps engineer, with the desire to grow into a customer-facing Solutions Architect role.

  • Proven ability to design and deploy solutions in cloud or on-premise environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, or hybrid).

  • Experience with Docker, REST APIs, and Python-based solutions.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with minimal supervision.

  • Strong presentation skills — able to engage both technical and business audiences.

  • Willingness to work European and U.S. hours as needed for customer collaboration.

  • Team player with a proactive attitude and strong sense of ownership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in AI/ML infrastructure, MLOps, or data engineering.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, model training workflows, or inference serving.
  • Previous experience in pre-sales, customer success, or technical consulting roles.

Customer Solution Engineer

Remote, Full Time

Role Summary

We are looking for an ambitious and technically-minded engineer to join our Customer Success organization. In this role, you will be the primary technical contact for ClearML customers post-sales, ensuring smooth adoption, troubleshooting complex issues, and driving a positive customer experience. This role is ideal for individuals with foundational experience in DevOps, AI, and Machine Learning who are passionate about applying their technical knowledge in a
customer-facing capacity.

What You Will Do

  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Own and drive resolution for technical incidents, leveraging knowledge of MLOps, AI/ML workflows, and infrastructure (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Compose, GPU clusters).
  • Deployment and Integration: Provide hands-on guidance for deployment and architecture questions, particularly for complex on-prem installations.
  • Customer Communication: Manage end-to-end customer interaction through platforms like Pylon, Slack, and email, providing regular status updates and translating complex technical details into clear, customer-friendly terms.
  • Pre-Sales/POC Support: Collaborate with the pre-sales team by assisting in technical evaluations and Proof of Value (POV) installations to ensure a seamless transition to the Customer Success team.
  • Incident Management: Follow the standard incident process, providing initial technical assessment, routing issues to R&D/DevOps when necessary, and ensuring tickets are never left without an update.
  • Process Improvement: Document root causes, resolutions, and common issues to minimize engineer context-switching and feed insights back to product and documentation teams.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3-5 years of experience in a technical role (e.g., DevOps, MLOps, or Support Engineering).
  • Foundational knowledge of Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) concepts and workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with core DevOps tools and concepts, specifically containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or similar tools).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage customer expectations and sentiment effectively.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, particularly for managing complex technical incidents or customer engagements.

Preferred:

  • Experience with the ClearML platform or other MLOps tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with a support ticketing system (e.g., Pylon) and CRM (e.g., Hubspot).

Marketing & Sales

Account Executive

Company Overview

ClearML delivers a comprehensive AI infrastructure platform for enterprise-scale GenAI, LLMOps, and MLOps. Our solutions optimize GPU utilization, automate workflows, and enable secure AI deployments across hybrid setups. Backed by NVIDIA and trusted by thousands of AI teams worldwide, ClearML drives efficiency for innovative organizations across every vertical. We operate fully remotely and prioritize personal accountability, growth, and a culture that values diverse perspectives.

Role Summary

The Channel Account Manager will be responsible for building and managing a portfolio of channel partners — including resellers, system integrators, OEMs, and technology partners — to drive indirect revenue growth for ClearML in the US market. This role bridges sales, partner enablement, and relationship management to expand ClearML’s reach through strategic partner ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle management: from prospecting and qualification to negotiation and closing, consistently meeting or exceeding quarterly and annual revenue quotas.
  • Prospect and qualify leads in AI-driven industries, targeting Infrastructure teams managing GPU/hardware, IT, and AI teams needing AI orchestration solutions.
  • Develop and manage relationships with channel partners, including OEMs, resellers, system integrators, consultants, and technology partners (e.g., NVIDIA, AMD, HPE), to co-sell ClearML solutions and drive joint revenue opportunities.
  • Coordinate prospect meetings, ensuring the right team members (e.g., Sales Engineers, Solutions Architects, and partners) support them; document minutes and status, handle timely follow-ups, keep the CRM up to date, and facilitate customer/team/partner communication.
  • Develop tailored value propositions showcasing ClearML’s benefits in cost savings, scalability, and AI acceleration, often highlighting partner integrations for enhanced value.
  • Collaborate with Sales Engineers, Solutions Architects, and partners to address client pain points, customize offerings, and execute co-selling strategies.
  • Track metrics like pipeline health, conversion rates, and revenue forecasts using CRM tools, including partner-sourced deals.
  • Build long-term relationships with clients and partners, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities post-sale.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and client feedback to inform strategies and partner program enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or related field
  • 4+ years in software/SaaS sales, ideally in AI, cloud, or tech infrastructure
  • Proven success in meeting/exceeding quotas and managing enterprise accounts
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC) and tools (e.g., Hubspot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand technical concepts in AI/ML and translate into business outcomes for customers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling Infrastructure, AI, or MLOps related software/hardware
  • Network in AI enterprise ecosystems, including experience with partner programs and co-selling
  • Track record in remote sales environments

What We Offer

  • Competitive OTE (base + commission), equity, and uncapped earning potential.
  • Remote work with flexible scheduling
  • Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision, and wellness programs
  • Professional development, including sales training and industry events
  • Supportive culture focused on innovation and professional growth

Channel Account Manager – US

Channel Account Manager at ClearML

Company Overview: ClearML delivers a comprehensive AI infrastructure platform for enterprise-scale GenAI, LLMOps, and MLOps. Our solutions optimize GPU utilization, automate workflows, and enable secure AI deployments across hybrid setups. ClearML maximizes AI performance while minimizing costs.

Role Summary: As a fully remote Channel Account Manager based in the United States, you will drive revenue growth by building and managing strategic partnerships with VARs and infrastructure resellers across the US. You will be responsible for recruiting, enabling, and growing channel partners who sell ClearML AI infrastructure platform alongside their hardware and software offerings.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Recruit, onboard, and enable new channel partners including VARs, distributors, and system integrators to resell and co-sell ClearML AI infrastructure platform across the US.
